summary: Comdial was founded in Oregon in 1977 as a telecommunications research firm. On October 1, 1982, it acquired the telephone manufacturing division of General Dynamics for $53.7 million. The acquisition gave Comdial a major product design and manufacturing operation based in Charlottesville, Virginia.
one_line: Comdial, a telecommunications firm founded in Oregon in 1977, acquired General Dynamics' telephone manufacturing division in 1982.
key_facts: Comdial was founded in Oregon in 1977.
Comdial was founded as a telecommunications research firm.

Comdial paid $53.7 million for the telephone manufacturing division of General Dynamics.
The telephone manufacturing division acquired by Comdial was a major product design and manufacturing operation.
The telephone manufacturing division acquired by Comdial was located in Charlottesville, Virginia.
